sheets.cover_title: ML FOYER · WALL PANELS, BACKING FRAMES, CLIPS, DRILLING · WALLS B + A
questions: Lower pier panels P48, P50, P55 (wall B) are {{h('P48')}} and P56, P59, P64 (wall A) {{h('P56')}} mm tall in ONE piece (MDF {{bu['panel_t']}}). Upper panels over the openings are up to {{w('P58')}} x {{h('P58')}} (P58) and {{w('P53')}} x {{h('P53')}} (P53), one piece. Can you make and ship these in one piece without risk of damage? Please state your maximum panel size; if a second joint is needed, where do you propose it?

Openings OA1, OA2, OB1: UCON proposal L-liner MDF {{ln('OA1')['t']}} (A-511): leg against the bare reveal, {{ln('OA1')['depth']}} past the wall face; flange {{ln('OA1')['flange']}} wide behind the panel, from the jamb line to the backing frame, so no raw wall shows in the panel joints; corners mitred 45. Changed from the Main Kitchen windows: wider flange, NO strips B / A on the panel back - the panel back rests on the flange. Pier panels stop {{pn('P59')['s0'] - op('OA1')['s1']}} short of the jamb line; the visible opening narrows by {{ln('OA1')['t']}} per side. Please confirm you supply the liners.

Your panel 56 (wall A) starts 210 mm above the floor. Our layout: all lower panels and frames stand on the stone plinth, top FFL + {{stone - ffl}} (Q8). Is your 210 the same plinth? Please confirm the panel bottom.

Office double door PANEL 5 (A-501 / A-502), built to the Main Kitchen DK1 profile: opening {{ow('OB2')}} x {{oh('OB2')}} from the subfloor, frame gaps {{dr('OB2')['gap_side']}} / {{dr('OB2')['gap_head']}}, jamb {{dr('OB2')['jamb']}} on a {{dr('OB2')['wall_t']}} wall (not surveyed), two leaves, claddings 2 x {{(dr('OB2')['clad_x'][1] - dr('OB2')['clad_x'][0] - dr('OB2')['leaf_joint']) / 2.0}} with a {{dr('OB2')['leaf_joint']}} joint, FFL + {{op('OB2')['clad'][2] - ffl}} to the panel joint {{op('OB2')['clad'][3]}} (your leaves 2 x 993 x 3038). Panels {{rebated}} pass in front of the frame and are rebated {{bu['rebate']}} at the back (A-701, D-sheets). Please confirm or send your detail.

Panels hang on Fastmount VL-03H clips, recess mount, male half in the panel back D{{@s['clips']['hole_d']}} x {{@s['clips']['panel_depth']}}. All drilling coordinates are given from the panel BACK (X from the left edge seen from the back, Z from the bottom edge); a control column gives X from the face. Please confirm before drilling - mirrored drilling is the main risk.

Finished floor assumed +{{ffl}} above the subfloor (2-1/4", as Main Kitchen); TM heights from FFL agree within 1 - 3 mm. Opening heads from the subfloor: A {{oh('OA1')}} / {{oh('OA2')}}, B {{oh('OB1')}} / {{oh('OB2')}}. Upper panels: P47 starts {{z0('P47') - oh('OB1')}} over OB1; wall A row at {{upper('A')}} = {{upper('A') - oh('OA1')}} over OA1, {{upper('A') - oh('OA2')}} over OA2; over the Office door the joint is {{seam('B')}}. Verify FFL and heads by laser before release.

Pier and closet widths per UCON survey differ from your drawing by up to 6 mm (B: {{pier('OB1','NB')}} / {{ow('NB')}} / {{pier('NB','OB2')}} / {{tail('B','OB2')}} vs 355.1 / 641 / 492 / 311; A: {{pier('OA1','NA')}} / {{ow('NA')}} / {{pier('NA','OA2')}} vs 352 / 645 / 357). Panels are laid out to the UCON survey.

Stone plinth by others as in the Main Kitchen (A-512): {{stn['t']}} thick, face flush with the panel face ({{bu['face']}} from the wall), top {{stone}} above the subfloor = FFL + {{stone - ffl}} (8 in), notch {{stn['notch']}} x {{stn['notch']}} at the top front edge; in front of the Office door frame the back is cut to {{stn['back_cut']}}. Please confirm the stone height for the foyer and who supplies it.

Shoe cabinets: the two closets differ, so the cabinets must differ in HEIGHT - each to fit its niche (UCON survey, walls fixed). NB (doors 27 / 28): niche {{ow('NB')}} x {{oh('NB') - ffl}} above FFL -> cabinet max {{cab_top('NB') - ffl}} above FFL (your drawing {{cab('NB')['tm_top_ffl']}}). NA (doors 23 / 24): niche {{ow('NA')}} x {{oh('NA') - ffl}} -> cabinet max {{cab_top('NA') - ffl}} (your drawing {{cab('NA')['tm_top_ffl']}} = {{tm_top('NA') - oh('NA')}} HIGHER than the niche). We assume {{cab('NA')['top_gap']}} clear to the niche head and {{cab('NA')['side_gap']}} each side (width {{ow('NB') - 2 * cab('NB')['side_gap']}} / {{ow('NA') - 2 * cab('NA')['side_gap']}}; your drawing shows 645 / 653.5 on B, 645 on A). Panels P52 / P61 start {{gap_over('NB')}} above the cabinet top ({{z0('P52')}} / {{z0('P61')}} from the subfloor). Please confirm both cabinet sizes W x H x D - are they already ordered?
sheets.questions_note: Red number = open question, marked with the same red bubble on the sheet it belongs to. Answers to be written in the ANSWER column and returned; the drawings are reissued after the answers.

G-001: Dimensions in mm per UCON site survey. Z from the top of the subfloor; finished floor FFL +{{ffl}} (Q6).
Build-up from the wall face: backing frame plywood 3/4" ({{bu['frame_t']}}) + clip gap {{bu['clip_gap']}} (Fastmount VL-03H, recess mount) + panel MDF {{bu['panel_t']}} = panel face {{bu['face']}}.

Panels: joints 10; lower panels stand on the stone plinth (top FFL + {{stone - ffl}}, Q8), 10 below the ceiling, 10 short of the wall ends. Panels over the openings start 10 above the head, over the closets 10 above the TM cabinet top; over the Office door the joint = the cladding top {{seam('B')}}.
Panel numbers = TM numbers (drawing 252502_FOYER rev 4): wall B P47 - P55, wall A P56 - P64. Material MDF {{bu['panel_t']}}, matte lacquer BIANCO PURO per TM.

Openings OA1, OA2, OB1: L-liner MDF {{ln('OA1')['t']}}, flange {{ln('OA1')['flange']}} to the backing frame, no strips (UCON proposal, A-511, Q2); pier panels stop {{pn('P59')['s0'] - op('OA1')['s1']}} short of the jamb line.
Office double door PANEL 5 by TM, drawn to the Main Kitchen DK1 profile (A-501 / A-502, Q4); panels {{rebated}} rebated {{bu['rebate']}} at the back over the frame.
Shoe cabinets in the closets (doors 23 / 24, 27 / 28) by TM, drawn as envelopes; the two differ in height, each fits its niche (A-513, Q9). Stone plinth by others (A-512, Q8).

Backing frames S01 - S28, clip holes in the frames: UCON shop and CNC - not for the factory. A frame member (or the liner flange) stands behind every panel joint - no raw wall in a joint; over the closets and the Office door a plywood LINTEL.
Panel recesses for the clips: by the factory per the D-sheets, BACK VIEW (Q5).
FOR REVIEW - not for production until the open questions are answered and the drawings are reissued.

A-100: Walls B and A face each other across the foyer; the distance between them is not surveyed - drawn schematic, not to scale between the walls. Plan: architect's (Passione, Main Level, sheet 01), reference only.
A-1: Survey by UCON. Zero = top of the subfloor; finished floor FFL +{{ffl}} (2-1/4", as Main Kitchen - to be verified on site, Q6). Openings run from the floor; closets hold shoe cabinets by TM. Stone plinth by others under the lower panels, top {{stone}} = FFL + {{stone - ffl}} (Q8).
Opening heads and FFL to be checked by laser before the panels are released for production (Q6). Widths against the TM drawing: Q7.
A-2:*: Pier frames from the stone top {{stone}} to the tier joint {{@s['levels']['tier_joint']}}, then to the band; above the openings one band of frames along the whole wall to the ceiling. Frames meet the liner flange at the openings and run to the closet / door jambs; a plywood LINTEL over the closets and the door; the band is cut at every vertical panel joint - a frame member behind every joint, no raw wall. A pier narrower than two 4" stiles gets one solid strip. Built and fixed by UCON.
A-3:*: Panels MDF {{bu['panel_t']}}, matte lacquer BIANCO PURO per TM; joints 10; lower panels on the stone top {{stone}} (Q8); horizontal joint {{seam('{w}')}} / {{upper('{w}')}}; panels over openings start 10 above the head, over the closets 10 above the cabinet top; top = ceiling - 10. Panel numbers = TM numbers (drawing 252502_FOYER rev 4).

One panel over each opening and closet - long panels, one piece (Q1). Pier panels stop {{pn('P59')['s0'] - op('OA1')['s1']}} short of the jamb line; L-liner MDF {{ln('OA1')['t']}} (strip + dashed flange, A-511, Q2).
A-3:B: Shoe cabinet by TM (A-513); Office double door by TM, panels {{rebated}} rebated over its frame (A-501, Q4).

Shoe cabinet NB by TM - HEIGHT DIFFERS FROM NA: max top {{cab_top('NB') - ffl}} above FFL (niche - {{cab('NB')['top_gap']}}), TM drawing {{cab('NB')['tm_top_ffl']}} (Q9). P52 starts {{gap_over('NB')}} above the cabinet top = {{z0('P52')}} (A-513).
A-3:A: Shoe cabinet NA by TM - HEIGHT DIFFERS FROM NB: max top {{cab_top('NA') - ffl}} above FFL (niche - {{cab('NA')['top_gap']}}), TM drawing {{cab('NA')['tm_top_ffl']}} = {{tm_top('NA') - oh('NA')}} too high (Q9). P61 starts {{gap_over('NA')}} above the cabinet top = {{z0('P61')}}, {{upper('A') - z0('P61')}} below the upper row (A-513).
A-5:OB2: OB2: Office double door PANEL 5 by TM, drawn to the Main Kitchen DK1 profile (TM D01 rev 5); opening per UCON survey {{ow('OB2')}} x {{oh('OB2')}} from the subfloor (Q4, Q6).
Double, opens into the Office (Passione plan), concealed hinges, soft-close closers (TM rev 4).
